texts.en:
A faulty relay is interfering with the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core. In addition to being immobilized, the lights are now going out on residential decks. Farms report irregular energy surges, and several key research modules have gone offline.

Our chief engineers warn that without intervention, cascading failures will spread throughout the ship. Unfortunately the solution is not straightforward. Repairing the relay will require diverting resources from our reserves, while bypassing it risks compromising the Arkship's long-term stability.

The cooling ship creaks and groans unsettlingly. We need to make a decision now.

label.en: Spare no expense and repair it properly.

texts.zh: 尽管困难重重，方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的工程船员不仅修复了故障继电器，还对其进行了改进。现在，全舰的能量分配比以往任何时候都更加顺畅，多年来一直不稳定的系统也得以稳定。船员士气大幅提升，许多人对方舟舰的韧性表现出了新的自豪感。
texts.en: Against all odds, the engineering crew on Arkship [Root.GetName] has not only repaired the faulty relay, but improved it. Energy distribution across the ship is now smoother than ever, stabilizing systems that have been temperamental for years. Crew morale has risen sharply, with many expressing newfound pride in the Arkship's resilience.

texts.zh: 对飞船[Root.GetName]能源核心的快速修复暂时有效。但临时旁路电路在持续使用下已不堪重负。频繁的全船断电已成为常态，一些区域的环境控制在过热和过冷之间摇摆不定。船员抱怨领导层选择了权宜之计而非安全。低语流传着，方舟舰正在变成一座修修补补的遗迹，而非一座坚韧的灯塔。
texts.en: The quick fix on the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core is holding, at least for now. But the makeshift bypass circuits are straining under constant use. Frequent ship-wide blackouts are now a way of life, and environmental controls in some sections have been oscillating between too hot, and too cold. The crew grumble that leadership chose expedience over security. Whispers circulate that the Arkship is becoming a patchwork relic, rather than a beacon of endurance.

label.en: We must make do and mend.

# 摇摇欲坠的核心 / A Faltering Core

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt、common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt、common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件：隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期检查，游戏前5年不会发生，每次约三分之一几率（中期前×1.5；近期参战或所有方舟都在战斗时为0）调用 generate_arkship_event 从 mobile_arkship_random_events 池（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，24项，总权重460）中抽取一件，否则3–5年后再试。多数事件设置一次性标记（个别如“出发！”可发生两次）；结束后约10–15年再重新开始检查。（池中权重 20/460，00_on_actions.txt:3992）
Nomad arkship random event: hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49) checks periodically — never in the first 5 years, about one in three (×1.5 before mid game, 0 during recent war or when every arkship is fighting) — and draws one episode from mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, 24 entries, total weight 460); otherwise it retries in 3–5 years. Most episodes set a once-only flag (Start Your Engines can happen twice); after it ends the loop resumes roughly 10–15 years later. (pool weight 20/460, 00_on_actions.txt:3992)

条件：本国尚未发生三件引擎故障事件中的任何一件。
Conditions: none of the three engine-trouble episodes has happened.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 故障继电器干扰动力核心：不惜代价修好 → 约半年后“元气满满的核心”；临时拼补 →“修修补补的危机”。
  A faulty relay: repair it properly → An Energized Core, or patch it → A Patchwork Crisis (about six months later).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 两个结果互斥；与另外两件引擎故障事件互斥。
  Two exclusive outcomes; exclusive with the other engine-trouble episodes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊差异。
  No notable variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：方舟事件循环 arkship.1 与随机池权重、本事件的触发条件与一次性标记、各选项的后续事件/项目与随机权重、延迟（@extremely_short_arkship_event_delay_days = 180 天，10_scripted_variables_nomads.txt:457）。
  Checked the arkship loop and pool weights, this episode's trigger and once-flag, options, projects, random weights and delays (180 days base).
- 说明 Note：地图上的延迟显示为未解析的脚本变量名，实际值见上（编译器请求）。
  Map delays show unresolved script variables; values are given above.
